durability.why_this_exists: A repair written straight to asset_registry survives only if its column is absent from asset_registry_seed.ts's `ON CONFLICT (asset_id) DO UPDATE SET` list. Columns in that list are restored from EXCLUDED on the next seed run. A green resting on such a column is a green a re-seed silently undoes, which is strictly worse than a red.
